evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - Restored a classic car in 2022 ("last year" as of 2023-05-01); thrilled by it — "nothing like bringing it back to life" — and shared a photo of the restored car's engine (with a small air filter) [S4T7].

- As of 2023-05-31, had recently fixed a neighbor's car engine himself — the neighbor "had been having some trouble with the engine", which is now done; shared a photo of himself working on the car engine in a garage. (Calvin recognized the car as the one Dave had been fixing the engine of "for a friend.") [S7T2][S7T3].

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-09-22, reported a setback on the vintage Mustang (the restoration car he had been updating Calvin on — see above; he had shown the "final result" on 2023-09-15): he had been working on the engine and thought he'd fixed it, but when he started the car up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in"; shared a photo of the engine (a car engine with a small engine) and asked Calvin "Take a look at the engine!" [S20T1].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-10-08, when telling Calvin about his car show and restored/modified car (details in ## Classic cars), said working on cars "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — it's "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress"; as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage, tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" (echoing his childhood memories of working on cars with his dad, see above); now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" [S22T5].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked "what made you start working on cars?") that his car passion started when he was ten: he'd been fascinated with how machines work, found an old car in a neighbor's garage, and asked if he could fix it — "that's when my love for car engineering began!" — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; comes with his remark that working on a car is his outlet — "a little oasis of calm" — where he's "connecting back with myself" — see the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; complements the childhood memories of tinkering with engines in his dad's garage recorded above; Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life.", and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is working on another project — Dave answered in the continuation of the same day's chat, which is not in this excerpt: he restored a car last year (2022, the 2022 restoration, see above) but sold it to a collector, and is now working on a new car project he finds quite a challenge [S25T14][S25T15][S25T16][S25T17].

- Current car project: has been doing engine swaps and suspension modifications, and is now learning body modifications; the project is giving a classic muscle car a modern twist — "a challenge but so fun" — and shared a photo of a silver Corvette parked in front of a building; Calvin praised the modern twist the silver finish gives [S13T7][S13T8].

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - "Loving this job" — works with awesome mechanics and shares his knowledge about cars; shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage and called the current project cool but a bit challenging [S5T3].

- On 2023-10-08, caught up with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! What's up?"): told him that last Friday (2023-10-06) he went to a car show — saw some awesome cars, got to mess with car mods, and there were so many cool machines around — "it was so much fun!" — and shared a photo of "this beautiful car" (a photography of two men looking at a car engine); Calvin: "Hey Dave, that sounds awesome! I'm into the rush of awesome cars. Can't wait to check out your garage." (shared a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom) [S22T1][S22T2]. Dave: "Thanks! Yeah, this one looks great!" and said he restored and modified the car himself, adding a custom exhaust and some performance upgrades — it's "got a sweet sound" and he's "really proud of how it turned out"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!" (shared a photo of a car driving down a street with a traffic light) [S22T3][S22T4]. Dave: "Thanks Calvin! I've spent a lot of time and effort on it. It's not just a hobby, it's a passion. It's like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress." and added that as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" — and now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" (details in ## Classic cars and ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); Calvin: "Wow, Dave, that's amazing. Bringing broken things back to life is so satisfying. Working on cars can be a real escape from reality, and I understand that feeling. Doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal, right? Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." [S22T5][S22T6]. Dave: "Thanks, Calvin. It's been my goal since I was a kid and it's awesome to be able to do something I love. Restoring things like this can be tough but the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great. Absolutely, I'm loving it." Calvin: "Go for it, Dave! Chasing your dreams is what life's about. It's awesome to see how far you've come. Keep working hard and living your best life." (Calvin's side of this whole exchange in the 2023-10-08 entry of ## Relationships in /memories/calvin.md) [S22T7][S22T8].

- On 2023-09-22, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin, good to catch up again!"): told Calvin he'd been working on the engine of the vintage Mustang — thought he'd fixed it, but when he started it up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in" — and shared a photo of the engine (a car engine with a small engine), asking Calvin to take a look (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin sympathized ("That must be disappointing after putting so much work into it") and shared a photo of his red sports car (Ferrari) parked in a parking lot as "a sign of my hard work and dedication"; Dave: "I love the way the sunlight hits this. It's definitely a great symbol of all your hard work. I bet you feel really proud when you look at it." and asked whether Calvin had any special memories with it; Calvin recalled an unforgettable summer drive ("the wind blowing through my hair and the rush of freedom") and said his trip to Japan was incredible — "already longing to go back," "an experience that made all the hard work worth it" (Calvin's side in the New luxury car and Japan plan sections of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "That feeling of freedom in the summer is the best. A moment of reflection not only makes the journey interesting but also productive!" — and asked whether any song from Calvin's childhood brings back memories; Calvin: "there's this one song that always makes me smile. It played during a road trip with my dad and we had so much fun singing along to it."; Dave: "Sounds awesome, Calvin! Road trips with family are always a treat. What's the name of the song?"; Calvin: "We used to rock a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre called 'California Love.' Ah, those were the days!" (song details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Sounds great, Cal! 'California Love' is a classic! Let me know if you wanna jam some music together!" — inviting Calvin to jam some music together (details in ## Music); Calvin: "Yeah, let's do it! That would be awesome."; Dave: "I'm stoked, Calvin! We can crank up the music and have an awesome jam session. Can't wait!"; Calvin: "Yeah, Dave! Gonna be great! Can't wait to see what we can do."; Dave: "Yeah, let's do it! It'll be awesome. Let's rock it!"; Calvin: "Yeah, let's do this! I can't wait!"; the conversation closed with Dave: "Nice one, Calvin! Let's make some awesome memories and have a great time. See ya soon!", and Calvin: "Count me in. Can't wait to create something special. See you soon!", and Dave's final parting: "Yep, Calvin! Can't wait to see you soon. Take it easy till then." [S20T1][S20T2][S20T3][S20T4][S20T5][S20T6][S20T7][S20T8][S20T9][S20T10][S20T11][S20T12][S20T13][S20T14][S20T15][S20T16][S20T17].

- On 2023-10-25, shared a photo of his latest car project (a group of people washing a car in a garage); Calvin: "that car looks awesome!" and asked what got him into engineering cars [S26T4][S26T5].
- On 2023-10-25, when asked (by Calvin) what got him into engineering cars, gave a second, complementary origin story: cars have "always been [his] thing" — his dad took him to his first car show when he was 10, he was "wow-ed," and "I was hooked and wanted to learn more"; now he's an automotive engineer, and it's "crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts" (complements the 2023-10-23 origin story — fascination with machines at ten and the neighbor's old car — in the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of this file; Calvin: "So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music.") [S26T6][S26T7].
